purpose: Research dashboard for public satellite anomaly status, GEO space-environment exposure, and time-linked anomaly/environment analysis.

scientific_boundary.space_weather_risk: Modeled environment exposure; not satellite health.
scientific_boundary.causal_link: Never inferred automatically. Correlation engine only summarizes environment before a reported event.

goes_public_status.note: OSPO status page is generally updated monthly; recent outages are handled separately.
